row.name: CACI International Inc. Class A Common Stock

checks.label: not up two days in a row
checks.threshold: up_run <= 1, counting days above +1.0%; veto at 3+ up closes of any size

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)
checks.note: today would be breakout 3 of this move

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=20 breakdowns=0 bursts_in_base=0 giveback=0.32 tightness=0.71 base_volume_vs_leg=0.75 base_volume_vs_avg=0.88
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average

notes: extension: close 0.9% vs its 20-SMA, -5.0% over 20 sessions
prior breakouts worked 3 of 4 (closed higher 3 sessions later, last 4 in 60 sessions)

claude.reason: The burst bar itself is only 2.57% — well below the 4%+ threshold Bonde requires for a true range-expansion day — and the shaded consolidation box shows roughly 20 sessions of wide, overlapping bars that chop between ~605 and ~650, with multiple red-green reversals and no clear tightening into the breakout. Most decisively, the checklist flags this as the third breakout of the same move (Y: FAIL), meaning the easy money from the August gap-up leg has already been distributed across two prior bursts.
claude.key_risk: Third breakout of a 44% move means late-cycle buyers absorb supply from those who rode the original August gap; a failure here has no nearby support until the 600 area.
claude.entry_note: Skip if the open is below today's close (~637) or if the first 30 minutes show no follow-through buying, confirming the weak burst gain was a one-day flicker rather than a new impulse.

row.summary: CACI: +2.6% on 1.2× volume out of a base 11.5% deep. C 8.5, 5 of 6 criteria.
